chunks: And in the narration of Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, it is reported that Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

Regarding two witnesses who testified to a woman that her husband had divorced her, so she remarried, and then her husband came back, he said: “The two shall be subjected to the prescribed punishment, and they shall be made liable for the dowry to the husband. Then the wife shall observe her waiting period and return to her first husband.”

key_terms.شَاهِدَيْنِ: two witnesses giving testimony in a legal matter

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two witnesses falsely testify that a woman was divorced and she remarries?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about false testimony in a marital case where a woman remarries on the basis of witnesses claiming that her husband divorced her. It states that the false witnesses are punished and held financially liable, while the woman observes her waiting period and returns to her first husband.
